title: 2014 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: The first AMC \(8\) was given in \(1985\) and it has been given annually since that time. Samantha turned \(12\) years old the year that she took the seventh AMC \(8.\) In what year was Samantha born?

solutions.text:
The seventh AMC \(8\) would have been administered \(6\) years after the first one. Therefore, Samantha took it in \(1985 + 6 = 1991.\)

This means that Samantha was born \(12\) years prior in \(1991 - 12 = 1979.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: The seventh AMC \(8\) was six years after the first AMC \(8.\)
Subtract Samantha’s age from that year.
